# Architecture Brief — v2.9.0 Teams Adaptive Cards

resource: scripts/harness/teams-notifier.mjs, package.json, scripts/harness/stage-state.mjs

**Date:** 2026-08-03  
**Status:** APPROVED

## Cards

| Template | Trigger | Key fields |
|---|---|---|
| `stage-complete` | Loop stage finished | loop, stage, status, iteration, duration |
| `approval-needed` | Approval marker in state | loop, stage, runId, note, CLI command to approve |
| `error-alert` | Loop exhausted/stuck | loop, stage, failedChecks, iteration |

## Webhook

Teams incoming webhook: `POST HARNESS_TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL` with  
`{ "type": "message", "attachments": [{ "contentType": "application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive", "content": <AdaptiveCard v1.5> }] }`

## Do-NOTs

- Do NOT add npm deps (use Node built-in `https`).
- Do NOT accept webhook URL as a CLI arg — env var only.
- Do NOT block the harness on webhook failure — exit non-zero but never throw to callers.
- Do NOT modify stage-state.mjs, run-loop.mjs, or report-server.mjs.
